title: Data Privacy Policy
summary: Synthetic GDPR-aligned privacy policy. The planned planted finding is that this document is compliant.

sections.title: Scope
sections.content: This policy applies to personal data processed by Acme Corp as a controller or processor in connection with customer operations, employee administration, marketing, and support.

sections.title: Lawful basis
sections.content: Acme Corp documents a lawful basis for each processing activity, including contract necessity for customer services, legitimate interests for security monitoring, consent for optional marketing, and legal obligation for employment and finance records.

sections.title: Data subject rights
sections.content: Data subjects may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, or objection through privacy@acme.example. Requests are logged, identity-checked, and answered within one month unless an extension is documented.

sections.title: Retention and minimization
sections.content: Privacy records are mapped to retention categories in the privacy register. Product telemetry is minimized before analytics use. Personal data is deleted or anonymized when the relevant retention period ends, unless legal hold applies.

sections.title: International transfers
sections.content: Transfers outside the EEA require an approved transfer mechanism, including Standard Contractual Clauses where appropriate, transfer impact assessment, and vendor due diligence.

sections.title: Governance
sections.content: The Data Protection Officer reviews high-risk processing, Data Protection Impact Assessments, and privacy incidents. Privacy training is assigned annually to employees who process personal data.

known_planted_findings.summary: The data privacy policy is GDPR-aligned for the purposes of this synthetic review.
evidence: The policy describes lawful basis mapping.
The policy describes data subject rights handling within one month.
The policy includes minimization, retention, transfer safeguards, DPIAs, and DPO review.
